files.master-detail-dialog.css: .dialog-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:1rem;background:#0f172a88}.master-detail{width:min(48rem,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 2rem);display:grid;grid-template-columns:15rem minmax(0,1fr);overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:.6rem;box-shadow:0 20px 50px #0005}.master-detail aside{padding:1rem;background:#f8fafc;border-right:1px solid #dbe1ea}.master-detail [role=listbox]{display:grid;gap:.25rem}.master-detail [role=option]{border:0;background:transparent;padding:.5rem;text-align:left;border-radius:.3rem}.master-detail [role=option][aria-selected=true]{background:#dbeafe;font-weight:600}.detail{padding:1.25rem}.detail dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:max-content 1fr;gap:.5rem 1rem}.detail dt{font-weight:600}.detail dd{margin:0}.detail footer{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:.5rem;margin-top:2rem}.primary{background:#1d4ed8;color:#fff;border:1px solid #1d4ed8;border-radius:.3rem;padding:.45rem .7rem}@media(max-width:600px){.master-detail{grid-template-columns:1fr}.master-detail aside{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #dbe1ea}.master-detail [role=listbox]{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(8rem,1fr))}}
